caption:
Creamy Mushroom & Spinach Frittata
high protein | simple breakfasts | filling breakfast | brunch | one pan recipe 

Nutrition: 
C: 7 | F: 23 | P: 18
Calories: 318 per serve without bread
Serves 2
(cut out the cheese to make it uunder 300 calories a serve)

Ingredients
100 grams button mushroom
handful of spinach, as much or as little as you want 
1 tbsp minced garlic 
small knob of butter
1 green chilli, finely sliced
2 tbsp - 1/4 cup amul cream, adjust for consistency 
1 tbsp milk, if needed to thin it out
20 grams cheese, grated (optional)
4 eggs
1 tsp black pepper 
pinch of salt
1 tsp red chilli flakes
handful of chopped coriander

Method
add mushrooms to a pan and allow to brown, add in the butter, garlic and green chilli and spinach 
cook for a minute then add in the cream and a little milk to thin the mix
add in your grated cheese, pepper, salt and chilli flakes
crack your eggs on top and cover and cook till eggs are done, i love a good runny yolk with the wrhites perfectly cooked
top with chopped coriander and enjoy with toasted bread
